# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `secondpage` MCP server pointing at SecondPage's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.secondpage.cc/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with SecondPage user login — no API key to configure.
- Logo: `plugin.json` references the publisher-submitted URL `https://secondpage.cc/brand/secondpage-tile-paper.png`; no local logo file is committed yet.
